plugins.name: Admin Commands
plugins.author: Vulpzin
plugins.changelog:
Names work in place of numbers: /arm uzi works as /arm 5. The new /names command lists them.
/car takes color=, enter, dist= and yaw=.
Answers say in plain words what happened. The target gets a notice. The setting notify_target turns it off (on by default).
A weapon goes to the other hand or to the inventory when the hand is full. Magazines go to the pockets.
Failed and dangerous commands go to the Aya log.

plugins.name: Bans
plugins.description: Bans that last after a restart, and kicks that let the player join again.
plugins.author: Vulpzin
plugins.changelog:
A player who is banned or kicked now sees a notice with the reason, then the connection ends a moment later.
/ban acc:N bans an account by number, also when the player is offline. An offline ban needs the permission bans.offline.
Bans also refuse the address of the player. Turn it off with the setting ban_address.
/ban PLAYER [TIME] [REASON] bans the account. TIME is 30m, 12h, 7d, 2w or perm.
/unban N, /bans [PAGE] and /baninfo N manage the list. /kick PLAYER [REASON] disconnects a player, who can join again.
Every ban, unban and kick goes to the Aya log.

plugins.name: Permission System
plugins.description: Groups, permission nodes and password login policy.
plugins.author: Vulpzin
plugins.changelog:
Edit groups in a text file. /group export writes user/plugins/sv.permissions.groups.ini. /group reload reads it back.
A file with an error changes nothing, and the answer says the line.
Only the owner group can reload. Group assignments to players still use /perm set.
